correctness.rationale: For S a set of cells in K_m x K_n, a cell (i,j) is uncovered iff every chosen cell shares row i or column j, equivalently S subset X_{i,j} (its row-column cross). Counting failed subsets disjointly by active row and column supports yields empty and one-support contributions with mnz correction, 2x2 supports with exactly 2 opposite pairs and 4 triples (not the four-cell set), 2-by-s>=3 supports with a unique singleton row, symmetric cases, and r,s>=3 paired-star supports with unique center row/column and optional central edge. These contributions match the printed B_{m,n}(z); T=(1+z)^(mn)-B. Full crosses are exactly mn maximal failures of size m+n-1. m=2 simplifies to (sum_{j>=2}binom(n,j)z^j)^2; for both dimensions>=3 minimum coefficient 6 binom(m,3)binom(n,3). Independent direct open-neighborhood enumeration matched all coefficients for (m,n)=(2,2),(2,4),(3,3),(3,4),(4,4), 70416 checked vertex subsets. Unrestricted proof is support classification.
